summary: Accepted Phase 2. The three automatable Phase 2 plan tasks are complete with commit evidence, UMV remains structurally blocked as deferred:user, FR4/FR5/FR6 are implemented with real Phase 1 validation/sanitization and real content hashing, the Review B cross-teacher review-ownership fix and Review C teacherFacingStatus/rejectionComment fix are present and tested, and all required acceptance gates exited 0 in this audit.
nonblocking_findings: Review A nonblocking item remains: editRejectedDraftHandler does not refresh lessons.metadata.authoringActivityIds after an edit-after-decision save, so repeated edits with multi-activity sections can leave orphan non-primary activity rows; current lifecycle, publish gate, and student-visibility tests remain green.
Review A nonblocking item remains: toTeacherFacingStatus falls back to a type cast for unexpected persisted status instead of throwing; current valid status mapping is pinned and tested.

The workspace contains unrelated dirty files before/after this audit (_add_types.py, _add_types.ts untracked; measure/monorepo-ops.md modified), but git history for the Phase 2 commits does not include _add_types.* and only a historical migration commit tracks measure/monorepo-ops.md; this audit did not stage them.
evidence: Plan Phase 2 block has exactly 3 completed automatable tasks, all marked [x] with commit 01752a0c evidence; the UMV task is [b] with trailing deferred:user; no bare [ ] marker appears in the Phase 2 block.

FR4 implementation verified in apps/integrated-math-3/convex/teacher/content-authoring.ts: submit/review/publish handlers call real computeComponentContentHash imported from apps/integrated-math-3/lib/activities/content-hash.ts and resolveComponentKind from review-queue.ts, create component_reviews/component_approvals rows, and reject publish unless current hashes match approved records.

FR5 implementation verified: lifecycle handlers persist draft/review/approved/archived/published status transitions, reject illegal direct publish paths, support edit-after-reject/edit-after-decision, expose teacherFacingStatus via toTeacherFacingStatus, and return rejectionComment on rejected/needs_changes decisions.

FR6 implementation verified: getAuthoringTeacher role gate and lesson metadata authoringTeacherId ownership checks guard mutations; assignment requires teacher-owned non-archived class and published lesson; student visibility requires latest published version, class_lessons assignment, active class_enrollments row, and same organization.

Tests execute real handler logic with a mock Convex ctx.db storage boundary and import the real Phase 1 normalizeLessonDraft, validateActivityConfig, sanitizeLessonDraft, and real computeComponentContentHash rather than broad mocks.

Review B security fix is present: reviewAuthoredLessonHandler rejects loaded.lesson.metadata.authoringTeacherId !== args.userId; adversarial test 'prevents a teacher from reviewing or approving another teachers submitted draft' passes in the targeted gate.

Review C UX/API fix is present and tested: LifecycleResult includes teacherFacingStatus and optional rejectionComment; tests map persisted statuses and assert rejected DTO returns teacherFacingStatus='rejected' and rejectionComment='Needs work.'.
